parameters.help_en: The name of the cloud service for event notifications. Currently, only oss is supported
parameters.help_zh: 事件通知云产品名称。目前仅支持 oss
parameters.name: product_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the event notification rule. This parameter cannot be empty
parameters.help_zh: 事件通知规则名称，不能为空
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The list of event types. The valid values depend on the selected cloud service. For example, if oss is selected, common values include ObjectCreated:PutObject and ObjectRemoved:DeleteObject. For more information, see the event notification documentation of the cloud service
parameters.help_zh: 事件类型列表，取值取决于所选云产品。以 oss 为例，常见值包括 ObjectCreated:PutObject、ObjectRemoved:DeleteObject 等，详见各云产品的事件通知文档
parameters.name: event_types

fields.help_en: Indicates whether the rule is matched
fields.name: match_state

parameters.help_en: The list of matching rules. You can specify up to 10 rules at the outer level. The rules are connected by the OR logical operator
parameters.help_zh: 匹配规则列表。外层最多 10 条规则，规则之间为 OR 关系
parameters.name: match_rules

parameters.help_zh: 已废弃字段。请使用 Endpoint
parameters.name: endpoints

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can generate the value from your client and ensure that the value is unique across different requests
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en:
The endpoint type. Valid values:

topic: The topic type. Topics support delivery to multiple subscription endpoints. You can add or remove subscription endpoints later.
queue: The queue type. Messages are delivered directly to the queue. This reduces the link path, but you cannot add new subscription endpoints later
fields.help_zh:
接入点类型。取值：

topic：  主题类型。主题支持投递到多个订阅接收端。后续也可以增加或删除订阅接收端。
queue： 队列类型。直接投递到队列。可以减少链路路径，但后续不可增加新的订阅接收端
fields.name: endpoint_type

fields.help_en: The actual value of the endpoint. If EndpointType is set to topic, this parameter specifies the topic name. If EndpointType is set to queue, this parameter specifies the queue name
fields.help_zh: 接收终端实际值。当 EndpointType=topic 时为 Topic 名称，当 EndpointType=queue 时为 Queue 名称
fields.name: endpoint_value

parameters.help_en: The endpoint that receives messages in the current subscription
parameters.help_zh: 此次订阅中接收消息的终端地址
parameters.name: endpoint

Data.description_en: The response data. If the rule is successfully created, the name of the created rule is returned
Data.description_zh: 响应数据，创建规则成功时，返回创建的规则名称

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
